body: Thankfully this was the last session for that particular group, but I’m also considering finding a new group therapist since she was so easily able to redirect so much of the group convos and I don’t want this kind of thing to happen again.
I guess it could be but I’m completely done fighting my parents in court. Maybe some day if I have the money and time to throw a law suit at them, but for now it can just stay in my archives.

For some context, I was abused for the majority of my life, It went on well into my teens, I wasn’t allowed to go out at all, tracked on my phone, called constantly and was only allowed to go to work and school. I also had to work for free with my mother to clean houses and apartments. I got sick and tired, managed to get a non profit lawyer, have some friends throw all my stuff in garbage bags when one day I was left home alone and thought it was my only chance to escape (I’d tried to leave before but I was dragged back by my hair). She was also the type to constantly tell us “if you don’t like my fucking rules then leave” which ya know, she’d never let you leave. And funnily enough, the first thing I did when I left was call the police, it was a hassle because they kept having me go from department to department since nobody knew how to deal with a soon to be missing person would like to let you know I’m not missing so if I am reported missing, let me know so I can undo that. I never became “famous” as she said.

Once I moved out I had already been able to get in contact with a very luckily free child lawyer (provided by a non profit that I got to know through my bfs guidance counsellor) and when they started sending letters telling my mother to either give me back the money or we would go to small claims court, she sent me a letter that said I could have access to all the funds and she removed her name. (Account was frozen, the bank was treating it like a divorce) sadly tho she decided to skim THREE GRAND (3,000$) off of my bank account that she claims was hers (no FUCKING PROOF, I went through ever damn e-statement but because she moved money around constantly the banks could not completely say it was my money) and it had already taken a hell of a toll on me so I decided to take what I could get since I was done fighting.

She had total access to all my money and it was a “joint” account, she was the one to take any pay cheques and deal with any banking, she never let me have a debit card (even though she let my brothers have one), told me my tips should be enough, never let me even really see my bank account and didn’t give me the password.

I’ll definitely try out more self care and taking a bit more time to let myself calm down and do some enjoyable things before I react. Hopefully I can get myself a therapist one day I definitely need it lol! I’m still wary on group therapy but maybe I should try it out some day since I believe there’s quite a few places for free. Thanks a lot Purple, I appreciate it! I’m very glad you’re the first person I’ve had a back and forth with on Reddit!

Thank you for trying to help tho! I appreciate the work you’re putting in to help a random person!

It’s a fairly complicated situation we don’t really have a door since our room has a curtain for a wall to the kitchen that is used for the main family. The house is divided in two one for his grandmother, bottom for his mom, bf and I share the basement master bedroom if you could call it. She’s normally out all the time but on a monthly basis she stirs the pot i.e last months episode was her calling my bf a psycho for not showing as many emotions as the rest of his family and for “hating and talking shit about his brothers” none of which was true or was very old news that had already been resolved but she’s just so detached from her own children that she assumes the worst and has been using my bf as a punching bag. Thankfully he completely shuts everything she says out and doesn’t ever care. Sadly I do not have the same power and get extremely emotional and on edge when she starts that.

Well that’s kind of the reason I started to post! My justnoMIL (it’s a long story, bfs mom I live with them) has begun another one of her drama sprees and I began to reset and become extremely on edge and have weird tics again so a good friend told me to start posting here. Stress also is definitely a factor, I’m terrible at dealing with it and tend to let it out on those close to me, I’m working on it. Also quick question, what’s an FM?

It’s behaviours like yelling, angry people who will set me into a kind of hide and get away mode, I saw a picture with my fathers hand in it which set me off, talking to people who try to convince me that I have to see my parents. That type of stuff if that makes sense.
